_meta.description: Budget allocation over a Bayesian media-mix fit's POSTERIOR, not its means: a compose `fits` entry samples a REG_MMM_BAYES model of the east market's weekly sales on tv and search ONCE (a short single chain for a quick run; return_draws keeps the draws), and an `optimize` block splits params.budget between the two channels to maximise their summed steady-state response(). Its `posterior` evaluates the objective on 15 of the fit's 20 draws (a seeded subsample) and maximises their 10% quantile — a cautious plan that holds up in 9 posterior draws of 10 — while the budget constraint holds on the mean over the draws. Each variable in `optimizations` adds `interval`, the 90% credible range of that channel's best spend when the block is re-solved on each draw alone (how far the posterior moves the plan), and `posterior` echoes the fit, the draws evaluated and how many re-solves converged. Drop `posterior` for the posterior-mean plan.
_meta.name: compose-posterior-budget
